verdict.rationale: Airwallex's docs describe international Transfers, Batch Transfers, and FX conversion capabilities, but none of the evidence makes any claim about transfer speed or an under-a-minute arrival time for cross-border payments. Webhooks are 'instant' but that refers to event notifications, not fund delivery. missing for 10: any documentation or claim about transfer speed/SLA, evidence of near-instant settlement times, or corridor-specific speed guarantees.
